1 · First half

How it started.

The Celtics led 30–23 after one quarter. At the half, the Celtics led 62–51.

2 · The difference

George: 36 points on 14-of-22 shooting

17 by halftime, 14 in just over seven minutes of the 4th.

3 · How it turned

Tied at 76 in the third, then a 24–6 Celtics run

George and Tatum combined for 57 of 123.

4 · Where it was won

Won it from three and in the fourth

Threes made 22–11; assists 28–23. Boston won the fourth quarter 32–19.

5 · Final

Celtics 123, 76ers 101.

From the 76ers’ side: Lost the fourth quarter 19–32, the stretch that decided it.

What it meant: the Celtics are 10–2, 1st in the East, with 99% top-6 odds now. The 76ers are 10–3, 2nd in the East, at 99%.
